IGUI_RCD_ManualTransmission_Tooltip: Shift gears with the configured keys. The server can disable this mode.
IGUI_RCD_AutomaticReverse_Tooltip: When stopped, braking input can select reverse and throttle input can select a forward gear.
IGUI_RCD_AnalogThrottle_Tooltip: Preserves the vanilla analog throttle level for gamepad triggers. Keyboard throttle remains digital.
IGUI_RCD_BurnoutSound_Tooltip: Plays the base-game tire-skid sound while the driven wheels rotate faster than the vehicle speed.
IGUI_RCD_ShiftUp_Tooltip: Request the next higher gear while manual mode is active.
IGUI_RCD_ShiftDown_Tooltip: Request the next lower gear while manual mode is active.
